lead_in: Catholic Encyclopedia on Isaac Jogues, who went back to his former captors: Ephesians 2’s “good works” and Luke 12’s being “rich toward God.”

excerpt.text: He immediately asked to be sent back to the Iroquois as a missionary, but only after much hesitation his superiors acceded to his request. On 27 September he began his third and last journey to the Mohawk. . . . The news of this change of sentiment spread rapidly, and though fully aware of the danger Jogues continued on his way to Ossernenon, though all the Hurons and others who were with him fled except Lalande.
